subject: Haaland tells Man City to 'step up' even after his late winner at Leipzig
title: Haaland's winner, then the step-up

lines.vo: Haaland scored the winner, then told his own team to step up.
lines.footage: Haaland winner RB Leipzig Manchester City highlights

lines.vo: Seventy-eighth minute, at Leipzig. His fourteenth goal of the season. City won three-two.
City had lost two league games in a row, the last one to Brighton.
Leipzig should put him on their season-ticket list. Thirteen goals against them, in nine appearances. More than against any other opponent.
Thirteen goals against Leipzig. Thirteen touches on the night. Erling loves that number.
lines.footage: Haaland touches stats graphic, match footage

lines.vo: Afterwards he said City should have been more aggressive after going ahead.
A winner, thirteen touches and a team talk. Fair enough, Erling.

inserts.story: A cartoon striker scores a late winner as the clock shows 78. Gag: the net bulges and a flurry of confetti falls. Twist: the confetti forms a number 14.
A cartoon striker's boot touches the ball thirteen times in a row, each marked by a number pop. Gag: the boot jumps and the numbers pile up like coins. Twist: the thirteenth touch is a goal.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon striker and touches counter

inserts.story: A cartoon striker stands at a whiteboard in front of his team-mates. Gag: he draws a big arrow that says More. Twist: team-mates salute and the arrow points at the ball.

facts_used: 78th-minute winner in City's 3-2 Champions League win at Leipzig; his 14th goal of the season and 13th against Leipzig (news 101; espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50382966)
